paste.title: Paste your text
paste.content: Start by pasting or typing your text into the editor.

lock.title: Lock the document
lock.content: Press K or click the lock button to switch to annotation mode.

annotate.title: Annotate your text
annotate.content: Select text to draw arrows (A), highlight (H), comment (C), or underline (U).

layers.title: Manage your layers
layers.content: Drag layers to reorder them, or drag to the trash to delete. You can also reorder sections the same way.

eraser.title: Erase annotations
eraser.content: Press E or click the eraser to remove highlights, underlines, and arrows from selected text.

unlock.title: Unlock to edit
unlock.content: Press K again to return to editing. Your annotations are preserved.

statusBar.title: Status bar
statusBar.content: Keep an eye here for instructions on how to use the tools or notifications.

share.title: Collaborate with others
share.content: Generate a read-only or editable link to share your annotated document with others.
